target: Pokédex 3D Pro demake for DS/DS Lite/DSi
release_policy: No release-complete claim until every mandatory feature is verified_complete with source and end-to-end evidence; hardware-inapplicable camera features must be gated on DS/DS Lite.

features.gap: C118 adds native libnds playback of optional privately recovered PCM16 title cues (P3SA) at source-specified original C117 title-frame events (CRC-checked P3TC), with valid static-title cue support, silence on missing source assets, safe audio-buffer lifetime, and stops on HOME transition. C117 P3TL image timings, C116 original separate dual-screen title assets remain required and not verified against the actual 3DS. Complete original 3DS title music, transitions, behavior, graphics and other menus/gameplay are not yet fully ported or visually/aurally verified.
C82 displays recovered original English names, descriptions, height and weight from private 649-record P3DX data; complete forms/stats/evolutions, final 3D rendering and localization still incomplete

C83 adds an A-Z text-mode touchscreen query, name/description matching, region and viewed/favorites scope controls, and previous/next results, but original 3DS art hitboxes and final visual/UI parity remain unverified

C100 displays and scrolls original recovered P3DM descriptions/effects for all 559 moves (548 nonempty description fields and 359 nonempty effect fields); original effect selection is available via X. Exact original 3DS visual layout, move battle metadata, audio and filters remain unverified.
Gen V dual type matchup calculation; original visual layout not verified
Six favorites persisted; verify original semantics and all input flows
Seven challenge modes implemented; 29 original modes remain unimplemented
C81 restores viewed history for 649 species, five regional totals, eight recent entries and seven challenge-mode highscores; original 36-mode records and original graphics remain incomplete
Basic list/page/delete; original photo associations, slideshow and DSi capture pending
DSi-only camera backend and AR tracking are not implemented

C101 integrates C98 source geometry selection into the latest C100 trunk: default recovered DS3M <=600 triangles, optional CRC-validated P3CS <=1800 original-derived source triangles, missing/corrupt chunk fallback to DS3M. 500 private source model samples exist but real melonDS private-data screenshots, full 3DS topology, texture sampler/animation parity and remaining gameplay are incomplete.

C116 filters C115 source-backed material ranges by original P3UV normalized 0–1 unit-square coverage, preserving safe material textures while drawing negative/>1-UV ranges untextured until original 3DS wrap/repeat/mirror modes are recovered. C115 mixed materials and C113/C112/C109/C108 original-source consistency remain. Source original shader sampler/UV transforms, model color/material fidelity and real private-original visual comparison are not verified.
Optional verified clip loader; original full animation library not confirmed

C118 integrates only short original-source PCM16 title audio cue playback from optional P3TC/P3SA private NitroFS files (no invented sounds, limited 32KiB per mono cue). Full source-original title theme/music, Pokémon cries, speech and gameplay effects remain unimplemented/not source-verified, and original-asset playback has not been compared with real 3DS recordings.
Detailed authentic species metadata screens and filters not integrated

Legacy P3SV and separate CRC-checked P3RC now persist favorites, cumulative quiz totals, 649 viewed flags, eight recent species and 7 implemented quiz highscores; original full data/save parity not verified
Rotation and original-art toggle exist; full original settings/UI customization unverified
Native DS touch keyboard and scoped search implemented in safe text mode; recovered original-art touch target mapping and complete original controls not verified
Smoke ROM CI is not end-to-end emulator and real DS/DSi proof
Source game contains multiple languages; native menu/text language switching and verified localization parity are not implemented
